use: Affiche d'annonce pour Discord : fin de développement de l'ending Ilonanium, neuf personnages face au lecteur.
prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing, illustration-story.
Deliver ONE spectacular FINISHED promotional poster for Discord announcing completion of the special ending ILONANIUM of the French visual novel MOULINETTE. A celebratory extra-diegetic ensemble key visual, not an in-game screenshot. Wide landscape 16:9, ideally 2560 x 1440 or 1920 x 1080, opaque full-bleed PNG. A premium anime space-opera movie poster, visually arresting at Discord preview size, beautifully composed and worthy of sharing.
REFERENCE INPUTS: All five images are references, not edit targets. Image 1 supplies SIX distinctive human characters and the established anime CG style. Reading that image left to right: ALLAN (grey officer cap, aviator sunglasses, commander's cape), MICKA (short grey hair and beard, no glasses, dark futuristic armor with red/white shoulder stripe), JESSY (glasses, long brown prophet beard, ivory white robe, crimson gem), THEO (grey combed hair, glasses and grey moustache, tan coat, green creeper keychain), FLORENTIN (silver hair, glasses, cheek scar, green/black armor with gold edges), SOFIANE (brown ponytail, glasses, short salt-and-pepper beard, blue-grey pilot suit with pouches and orange trim). Preserve those six distinct identities and outfits, but CHANGE THEIR GAZES to look directly at the viewer.
Image 2 supplies ILONA, the ONLY woman: long chestnut-brown hair, large rectangular dark glasses, brown eyes, red plaid shirt and jeans.
Image 3 supplies MONSIEUR LAPLAGE, a separate older white-haired man with a white moustache, NO glasses, tan coat and black turtleneck. Preserve his friendly signature THUMBS-UP, looking at us. Include both Theo AND Laplage as two separate people; don't merge them. Only Theo carries the green creeper keychain; Laplage's pocket is empty.
Image 4 supplies ALEXANDRE: stocky older man with rectangular glasses, full salt-and-pepper beard, green bucket hat, vivid pink Hawaiian shirt with yellow flowers, wooden walking cane. Relaxed amused warmth. Make him clearly visible, not a tiny hidden cameo.
Image 5 supplies the background's monumental concentric RING-SHAPED TAIKUN spaceship and the ILONANIUM: a colossal planet whose clouds and continents subtly form Ilona's face and huge eyes.
CAST CHECKLIST: exactly NINE human characters, each appearing once: Ilona, Jessy, Theo, Monsieur Laplage, Allan, Micka, Sofiane, Florentin, Alexandre. All nine faces must be clearly visible and recognizable. No additional anonymous humans. The environmental planet's eyes are not an additional human.
CRITICAL USER REQUEST: Every one of the NINE HUMANS faces the camera and LOOKS STRAIGHT AT THE VIEWER, like a fourth-wall-breaking invitation. No profiles, no backs of heads, no one looking out of a window, offscreen or toward another character. Do not inherit the sideways gazes of image 1.
COMPOSITION: a coherent, dynamic ensemble celebration, natural chest-up/waist-up poses in a balanced cinematic pyramid or two staggered tiers. Ilona and Jessy prominent near the center, with the others flanking them and in a gently elevated back tier, every face unobstructed. Invite the audience into their strange adventure. Warm proud smiles, charisma, emotional relief, a little absurdity. Laplage's thumb-up and Alexandre's pink shirt add the game's distinctive humor. Do not create a rigid pasted-sprite lineup: redraw everyone in one shared illustration, with coherent lighting and convincing anatomy. Keep the nine individual identities distinct; especially distinguish Theo's moustache and glasses, Laplage's white hair and no glasses, Jessy's LONG brown beard, Florentin's cheek scar, Sofiane's ponytail, Allan's cap, and Micka's red-striped armor.
ART DIRECTION: Grand cosmic space opera in the established polished hand-drawn anime visual novel style, detailed painterly cel shading, expressive faces, fine dark lines, luxurious fabric and intricate armor, no photorealistic skin. Deep indigo/teal space and nebula wisps contrast with amber gold and soft magenta rim light, unifying the ensemble. The immense Ilonanium planet curves behind the cast with a dreamlike cloud-face; the TAIKUN's concentric rings arc behind/above them like a huge metallic halo, faithful to reference 5. Two restrained distant suns, orange-red and pale gold, evoke the exoplanet. Optional small blue police-box TARDIS as a restrained Easter egg at the side if room allows. The result should feel epic, hopeful, surprising and a bit gloriously absurd, not grim or generic military sci-fi. Beautiful depth, clear hierarchy, controlled light effects. No gore or combat.
TYPOGRAPHY: polished promotional design, high contrast, clean spacing and excellent legibility at small size. Exactly FOUR text blocks, correct French spelling and accents:
Small top branding: "MOULINETTE"
Huge dominant cinematic title: "ILONANIUM"
Bold announcement underneath: "L'ENDING EST TERMINÉ"
Smaller closing line: "Le berceau de l'humanité vous attend."
Title in gorgeous ivory/gold sci-fi display lettering with subtle metallic dimensional light, generous tracking, immensely readable. Use clean lower negative space and a controlled dark gradient under the text, rather than covering faces or Jessy's gemstone. Keep every letter entirely inside the frame, with generous safe margins. No extra text, no invented release date, no price, no Discord logo, no UI, no watermark, no border. A single full-bleed finished image.
